x: Outstanding Belgrave performer at this evening meeting was Mike Smithers who long jumped 21'5¾" - a mere 9¾" behind U.K. record holder John Howell (H.H.H.) Bill Kerr (9:20:0) was a comfortable winner of the 2 miles but was edged out in the mile by team-mate John Thresher (4:26:4).

His 22'-4" in the latter was only 1" inferior to that of the senior winner, international John Howell. Just to show that we were not a one man outfit Arnold Bent turned on the heat with a Junior high jump win of 6'-1" and, to keep Steve company, finished runner-up in the long-jump just 7" behind his club mate.
